prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational.
Asset type: retained draft exercise illustration, one adult male demonstrator, one single held pose.
Primary request: Supine wall-supported ankle-over-knee piriformis stretch. Full body lying on back on a flat floor, head and back and pelvis supported on floor. His unaffected supporting leg is bent with its bare sole visibly flat against a vertical wall. His other affected hip opens outward with the affected ankle resting across the supporting thigh just above that supporting kneecap. The crossed foot is off the wall. Both arms lie straight alongside his trunk, palms down on floor. Calm static hold.
Style: thin pure-white contour lines only, transparent canvas AND transparent body/clothing interiors. Sparse anatomical details, simple clean continuous outlines, no filled body silhouettes. Adult male, short hair, bare torso, plain exercise shorts, bare feet. Minimal white outline of vertical wall and floor junction only, no room detail.
Composition: square canvas, full body with margins, elevated three-quarter oblique side view. Head at lower left, hips central, supporting foot against wall at upper right; choose camera high enough to make the crossed ankle visibly rest above the opposite knee and the supporting sole-wall contact unmistakable. Both arms and hands visible, natural proportions. No cropping. Wall may be shown as sparse thin white corner lines with transparent interior.
Constraints: exactly two arms, two legs, two feet; anatomically coherent continuous limbs. Ankles and knees clearly distinguishable. No numeric angles, no motion, no alternate pose, no arrows, no text, no labels, no shading, no glow, no color, no dark background, no white filled surfaces, no pillow, no bench, no mat or other invented equipment. One held pose only. This is draft illustration artwork, not a prescription.
